when: 2026-08-09, taken on branch feature/358-returning-hero at checkpoint 2
what: Criteria 2 and 3 of Issue #358: the raider who left alive is back two waves later under the same name, and the wave he is back in did not grow.

base.howObtained: git worktree add --detach ../_wt-358-base origin/main, then git log --oneline -1 in it

howObtained.theNumbersBelow: printed by Report_the_returning_raiders_of_the_shipped_journals in the same run

criterion2_absentThenBack.whereItIsInTheSnapshot: raiders[].returnedFromWave and raiders[].name, plus the survivors[] section, which carries the same six with status 'returned' and the raider id each came back as.

beforeTheChange.howObtained: the same fixture and seed run on dc15bc2 in ../_wt-358-base, see evidence/358-strengthening.json

criterion3_theWaveDidNotGrow.reading: the same nine places, six of them filled by people the domain has already met.

returnsThePartyHasNoRoomFor.rule: escapedWave + T.returning_raider_wave_gap (2). A return wave past T.wave_count is recorded with status 'no_wave_left' rather than dropped.

howTheCountWasObtained.command: dotnet run -c Release --project ./tests/DungeonFortress.Scenarios -- --prototype --commands ./scenarios/prototype1/baseline.commands.v2.json --ticks 2700 --snapshot ./.artifacts/probe/f2.json  &&  python -c "import json, collections; s = json.load(open('.artifacts/probe/f2.json', encoding='utf-8')); print(len(s['survivors']), dict(collections.Counter(v['status'] for v in s['survivors']))); print(collections.Counter((v['escapedWave'], v['status']) for v in s['survivors']))"
howTheCountWasObtained.correction: this file and SLICE_05_RETURNING_HERO.md said 16 no_wave_left in the first round. That number was counted off the printed report by eye and was wrong by one; independent review of PR #360 caught it (F2). It is now read off survivors[].status by the command above.

returnsThePartyHasNoRoomFor.whyNoRoomInWaveIsZeroHere: the shipped party never has more survivors due back in one wave than that wave has places. The branch exists because it can be reached — twelve escapes into a four-place wave — and it is held by the same status vocabulary the test asserts over.
